verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents its own programmatic surfaces: a CLI covering projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks, with stable `--json` output and meaningful exit codes, plus an MCP that lets agents read and update Foreloop. Nothing documents an HTTP API or full UI parity, and some actions appear only in the UI or GitHub, such as opting into a failure threshold, 'Link PR in the intention', and choosing a project for feedback routing. Missing for 10: a documented REST/HTTP API, an explicit UI-parity claim or coverage matrix, programmatic access to org settings (failure thresholds, feedback routing, widget keys), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks from a terminal — and from anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron.
--json works on any command and has a stable shape. Additive changes only.
The CLI and MCP let agents read and update Foreloop.
